blinding_guess.why: All six listed fields are populated on every generation path (PTP, LIN/CIRC via generateJointTrajectory, blending), and CommandListManager removes points with duplicate time_from_start before execution; nothing in the listed elements looks wrong on reading, but nothing rules out a timing or velocity/acceleration inconsistency either.

notes: This package produces trajectory_msgs/JointTrajectory in-process: generators fill a default-constructed JointTrajectory (src/trajectory_generator.cpp:355) and hand it to robot_trajectory::RobotTrajectory::setRobotTrajectoryMsg (src/trajectory_generator.cpp:273); the sequence action/service return it inside moveit_msgs (getRobotTrajectoryMsg). No publisher, subscriber or client carries these fields in this package's own code, so QoS and rates are null (not applicable), not unknown. The field definitions live in trajectory_msgs (ros2/common_interfaces), not in this package; declares records their types as written there, and each is written by this package's code (provenance lists the write sites). trajectory_msgs is not a direct <depend> in package.xml (reached transitively through moveit_msgs/moveit_core). The JointTrajectoryPoint.effort field is never written. Header/frame_id of the JointTrajectory is never set; all data is joint-space, hence frame 'none'. First sampled point has time_from_start 0 (t_sample starts at 0.0); the PTP goal-already-reached branch emits a single point at time_from_start = sampling_time (src/trajectory_generator_ptp.cpp:125). action:/panda_arm_controller/follow_joint_trajectory (consumes): not named anywhere in this package (grep of the whole package for panda_arm_controller, follow_joint_trajectory, FollowJointTrajectory, control_msgs: no hits). Execution goes through MoveIt's plan_execution/trajectory execution manager (src/move_group_sequence_action.cpp:177, context_->plan_execution_->planAndExecute) whose controller action names come from run-time controller configuration outside this package (tests load config/prbt_controllers.yaml from another package, test/unit_tests/launch/common_parameters.py:17). Hence no port, and it is in neither references nor declares.
